description: Nicosia's non-motorised segmented street network - manually edited. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ana Ricchiardi, Ilaria Geddes (University of Cyprus). A dataset containing spatial and attribute data for non-motorized segmented street network. Coordinate System: CGRS93 Zone extent: The extents of the dataset refers to the Urban Morphological Zone (UMZ) of Nicosia, Cyprus, and a buffer of 20 km around it. Coverage: national (CY); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
